news.headline: Morgan Stanley Raises Abivax Price Target to $180 Ahead of FDA Pre-NDA Meeting
news.summary: Morgan Stanley lifted its price target on Abivax to $180 from $132 while maintaining an Overweight rating, citing confidence heading into the company's scheduled July 30 FDA pre-NDA meeting for obefazimod. The upgrade added to a string of bullish analyst moves following June's positive Phase 3 maintenance data.

news.headline: Abivax Strengthens Commercial Capabilities With Strategic Leadership Appointments
news.summary: Abivax named four new commercial leaders spanning marketing, patient services, sales and market access to build out its U.S. go-to-market team ahead of a planned NDA filing for obefazimod in ulcerative colitis in Q4 2026. The hires signal the company is preparing to commercialize independently rather than solely relying on a partner.

news.headline: Abivax Re-engages Centerview Amid Renewed Takeover Interest
news.summary: French outlet La Lettre reported Abivax has re-engaged bank Centerview as takeover speculation resurfaced, with some analysts modeling a deal as large as $23 billion. No formal offer or process has been confirmed by the company.

news.headline: Valerio Therapeutics Announces Development Collaboration With Abivax
news.summary: Valerio Therapeutics signed a binding term sheet for an exclusive worldwide R&D collaboration with Abivax to design next-generation candidates for immune-mediated inflammatory disease, combining Abivax's disease expertise with Valerio's targeting platform. Valerio would receive an upfront payment of up to about EUR2.4 million plus future milestones and royalties once a definitive agreement is executed.

news.headline: Abivax's $920 Million Cash Haul Lets It Prepare for Solo U.S. Launch, CEO Tells CNBC
news.summary: CEO Marc de Garidel told CNBC the freshly raised $920 million gives Abivax the option to launch obefazimod in the U.S. on its own rather than needing a Big Pharma partner or acquirer. The comments came amid persistent takeover speculation around the company.

news.headline: Abivax Reports Positive ABTECT Maintenance Part 2 Results for Obefazimod in Refractory Ulcerative Colitis Patients
news.summary: Supplemental Phase 3 data showed obefazimod produced meaningful clinical and endoscopic remission in a highly refractory UC population, and that dose escalation to 50mg could recapture remission after relapse. Safety data, including malignancy rates, remained consistent with expected UC background rates, reinforcing the drug's benefit-risk profile.

catalysts.label: FDA pre-NDA meeting
catalysts.detail: Abivax is scheduled to meet with the FDA to discuss the New Drug Application package for obefazimod in ulcerative colitis; outcome/minutes typically inform final filing details. As of this update (2026-07-29) the meeting has not yet occurred and its outcome is the single most important near-term event to watch.

catalysts.label: NDA submission to FDA
catalysts.detail: Company guidance calls for submitting the NDA for obefazimod in ulcerative colitis to the FDA in late Q4 2026, following the pre-NDA meeting.

catalysts.label: H1 2026 financial results
catalysts.detail: Abivax's financial calendar lists H1 2026 results reporting for this date, which should also include an operational/program update.

catalysts.label: ENHANCE-CD Phase 2b Crohn's disease induction data
catalysts.detail: Topline 12-week induction results from the Phase 2b ENHANCE-CD trial of obefazimod in moderate-to-severely active Crohn's disease are guided for mid-2027, representing the company's next major pipeline readout beyond ulcerative colitis.

catalysts.label: Potential M&A / takeover resolution
catalysts.detail: Persistent takeover speculation (Eli Lilly and AstraZeneca reported interest earlier in 2026; Centerview re-engaged in mid-July with deal size estimates up to $23 billion) continues, but no formal offer has been confirmed by the company.

pulse: Abivax heads into its pivotal FDA pre-NDA meeting (scheduled 2026-07-30, imminent as of this update) riding strong momentum from June's positive Phase 3 ABTECT maintenance data, a $920 million financing close, and new U.S. commercial leadership hires as it targets a Q4 2026 NDA filing for obefazimod in ulcerative colitis. Renewed takeover speculation (Centerview re-engaged mid-July, deal estimates up to $23 billion) keeps M&A optionality alive even as management publicly emphasizes a path to independent U.S. launch, and analyst sentiment remains bullish with Morgan Stanley's price target now at $180. The outcome of the pre-NDA meeting is the immediate catalyst to watch, with H1 2026 results (September 21) and Crohn's disease data (mid-2027) further out on the horizon.
